title.zh: 在三宝颜市Limaong描笼涯设立国立中学，名称为Limaong国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Limaong, City of Zamboanga to Be Known as Limaong National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Limaong, City of Zamboanga to Be Known as Limaong National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Limaong, Thành phố Zamboanga được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Limaong
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Limaong, เมือง Zamboanga ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Limaong
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Limaong, Kota Zamboanga dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Limaong
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Limaong, Bandaraya Zamboanga dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Limaong

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9081_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay Limaong, City of Zamboanga to be known as Limaong National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, April 8, 2001.
